summary: Citation-coherence repair: the newest revisions of the two dependent accounts had dropped execution citations their text still relies on, so this update restores them without changing any conclusion, defect judgment or limit. The repair-path interpretation now cites the healed-divergence receipt it argues from alongside the per-node repair, restore, long-run and configuration-change receipts, with a joint history naming each; the child question's account now cites the split, healing, applied-state, control, per-node-repair, long-run, configuration-change and restore receipts in its execution map and traces each cited index in its rationale, while keeping its conclusion explained/asserted and its limits as they stood (single harness-issued AddVoter, entry-count long run, harness-arranged lag for the per-node repair, self-produced snapshot for the restore, ordinary log comparison argued unable to reconcile the divergence from the vote rule, in-memory stores with scaled timeouts). No experiment was run this turn: every registered question is explained with no open necessary gap, and the remaining items are standing limits rather than unanswered questions. The run's substantive conclusions are unchanged: the RestoreCommittedLogs startup path leaves a restarted node with the snapshot's membership instead of the configuration recorded in its own committed log, which permits a minority-quorum leader, conflicting commits at the same index and term, and applied state that diverges until the node's state is replaced; separately, the same replay can leave NewRaft unable to return when the batches it must hand to the FSM mutation channel exceed that channel's capacity before the consumer starts, which is reachable at default batch settings when a node's snapshots fail.
